mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS chk_cnt FROM EMP_MASTER EM ,TB_ATT_CONTRACT_N TACN WHERE TACN.TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID = EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER AND TACN.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{organizationId} AND EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER = #{employeeNumber} AND EM.FSE_YN = 'N' AND EM.FLSA_YN = 'N' AND EM.STATUS = 'Active Assignment'
mapper.insert: insert into tb_att_contract_n (SUBSIDIARY_CODE, TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID , ORGANIZATION_ID , EFFECTIVE_START_DATE , CREATION_USER_ID , CREATION_DATE , LAST_UPDATE_USER_ID , LAST_UPDATE_DATE) SELECT 'LGDVN' ,P.ATTRIBUTE2 ,O.ORGANIZATION_ID ,SYSDATE ,'-9' ,SYSDATE ,'-9' ,SYSDATE FROM LGCOM_IMPORT_N P, org_master O WHERE o.acc_org_code = P.ATTRIBUTE6 AND P.session_id = #{sessionId} AND P.seq_no > 1 AND (P.ATTRIBUTE2, O.ORGANIZATION_ID) NOT IN (SELECT C.TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID, C.ORGANIZATION_ID FROM tb_att_contract_n C)
mapper.update: DELETE FROM tb_att_contract_n c WHERE (c.TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID, c.organization_id) in ( SELECT P.ATTRIBUTE2 , O.ORGANIZATION_ID FROM LGCOM_IMPORT_N P, org_master O WHERE o.acc_org_code = P.ATTRIBUTE6 AND P.session_id = #{sessionId} AND P.seq_no > 1 )
